name: Sigil of Trollbane
summary: In Hammerfall, Zengu sends you deep into Stromgarde for the Sigil of Trollbane. Prince Galen keeps the last sigil, which is needed to claim Trol'kalar.

sections.title: The Last Sigil
sections.body: Prince Galen, son of Thoras Trollbane, keeps the last sigil in Stromgarde. He waits in a chapel deep in the districts held by the militia. Zengu warns that Galen is well guarded and a fine fighter. You are to kill the prince and carry the sigil back to Zengu in Hammerfall.

sections.title: Zengu's Verdict
sections.body: Zengu asks whether the line of Ignaeus Trollbane is broken. When it is, he declares that Trollbane blood will no longer haunt his people. They now hold every sigil needed to claim Trol'kalar. Zengu vows they will soon strike at the trolls of Zul'Gurub, whom he hates.

faq.q: Who sends you to retrieve the Sigil of Trollbane?
aliases: where do i start sigil of trollbane
faq.answer: Zengu sends you from Hammerfall to retrieve the Sigil of Trollbane.

faq.q: Where is Prince Galen Trollbane located?
faq.answer: Prince Galen Trollbane waits in a chapel far inside Stromgarde, in the districts held by the militia.

faq.q: Why is the Sigil of Trollbane needed?
faq.answer: The Sigil of Trollbane is the last sigil Zengu needs to open Thoras Trollbane's tomb. Thoras's son, Prince Galen, keeps it himself.

faq.q: What comes after obtaining the Sigil of Trollbane?
aliases: next quest after sigil of trollbane
faq.answer: After you obtain the Sigil of Trollbane, the chain continues with Trol'kalar.
